task.title: Logging into Quay.io
task.shortdesc: To sign in to Quay.io, you can use the Quay.io UI with your Red Hat credentials. On first login, you confirm the generated username.

ul.li: You have created a Red Hat account and a Quay.io account. For more information, see "Creating a Quay.io account".

step.cmd: In the navigation pane, select Sign In and log in using your Red Hat credentials.
If it is your first time logging in, you must confirm the automatically-generated username. Click Confirm Username to log in.

info.p: You are redirected to the Quay.io repository landing page.
